notes: Refined API/UI exposure to include tool_router boundary explicitly; no new story IDs created.

change_log.value: Integrate provider_search_service into find_care_facade and expose it through tool_router, coordinating specialty identification, query expansion, and location normalization, and ensuring clean handoff between preprocessing and search execution without duplicating domain logic.

stories.title: Enforce Canonical Provider Search Contract
stories.description: Ensure provider_search_models strictly define and validate the canonical input/output contract (query, specialty, location, filters, ranked results, scores, metadata) with no embedded business logic, enabling consistent interaction across tool_router and facade layers.

stories.title: Implement Vector Search with Deterministic Fallback Boundary
stories.description: Implement provider_search_service execution pipeline using MongoDB Atlas vector search with explicit scoring thresholds, and enforce deterministic transition to NUCC taxonomy fallback when thresholds are not met, including controlled geographic narrowing stages.

stories.title: Orchestrate and Expose Provider Search via Facade and Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate provider_search_service into find_care_facade and expose it through tool_router, coordinating specialty identification, query expansion, and location normalization, and ensuring clean handoff between preprocessing and search execution without duplicating domain logic.

stories.title: Comprehensive Test Coverage for Search Ranking and Fallback
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests validating ranking accuracy, threshold-triggered fallback behavior, geographic filtering stages, and edge cases (empty results, ambiguous queries, malformed inputs), ensuring regression protection.

stories.title: Validate End-to-End Embedding and Search Integration
stories.description: Validate alignment between provider embeddings generated in DataPipelines and runtime search behavior, ensuring vector index consistency, embedding quality, and correct retrieval behavior across environments.
